key: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
english: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: 使用這台 Mac 上安裝的 Codex 與你的 ChatGPT 登入；請求會計入你方案的用量限制。請在「終端機」中執行一次 `codex login` 以登入。推理強度：none、minimal、low、medium、high、xhigh 或 max。模型留空時使用 Codex 的預設值。

key: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
english: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: 使用這台 Mac 上安裝的 Antigravity CLI 及其登入的 Google 帳號；請求會計入該帳號的限制。請在「終端機」中執行一次 `agy` 以登入；`agy models` 會列出模型 ID。推理強度：low、medium、high 或 max，僅適用於本身未帶等級的模型 ID（以 -high、-medium 或 -low 結尾的模型會忽略此設定）。執行時使用 agy 的 hearsay-notes 專案，其拒絕規則讓模型除了網路搜尋外無法使用任何工具，且每次執行的對話之後都會從 agy 的歷史記錄中刪除。

english: The server sent an unexpected response for %@.
comment: Model download error. %@ is a file name.
translation: 伺服器對 %@ 傳回了非預期的回應。

key: The transcript, recording and any earlier notes keep their original names.
english: The transcript, recording and any earlier notes keep their original names.
comment: Follows a write error: nothing was renamed.
translation: 逐字稿、錄音及先前的筆記都保留原始名稱。

key: These files could not be restored: %@.
english: These files could not be restored: %@.
comment: Follows a file error. %@ is a comma-separated list of file paths.

key: This sounds like %@. Transcribe again in %@?
english: This sounds like %1$@. Transcribe again in %2$@?
comment: Language banner. Both %@ are the same language name in its own language (English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, Deutsch, Español).
translation: 這聽起來像是 %1$@。要以 %2$@ 重新轉錄嗎？

comment: Confirm sheet caption. %@ is a language name, possibly followed by an explanation in parentheses.

key: Unable to move the current notes (%@) to the Trash: %@.
english: Unable to move the current notes (%1$@) to the Trash: %2$@.
comment: Regenerate notes error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ the system error message.
translation: 無法將目前的筆記（%1$@）丟到垃圾桶：%2$@。

comment: Naming error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ a file name, %3$@ the system error message.
Naming error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ the system error message.
Audio error. %@ is a technical detail in English.
CLI check result. %1$d is the exit code, %2$@ the log-in hint. Keep `agy models`.
translation: `agy models` 執行失敗（結束代碼 %1$d）。%2$@

comment: Bundle display name. Product name: keep "Hearsay" untranslated. Do not translate: repeat the English exactly.

english: Hearsay captures the audio of your calls so both sides of a meeting are transcribed.
comment: Privacy - Audio Capture Usage Description. macOS shows it when Hearsay first asks to capture system audio (the other side of a call).
translation: Hearsay 會擷取通話的音訊，以便轉錄會議雙方的內容。

english: Hearsay records meetings you start and transcribes them on this Mac.
comment: Privacy - Microphone Usage Description. macOS shows it when Hearsay first asks for the microphone.
translation: Hearsay 會錄製你開始的會議，並在這台 Mac 上轉錄。

english:
© 2026 Chihling Wang. MIT License.
Includes open-source software; see Settings > General > Acknowledgements.
Support Hearsay: Buy Me a Coffee
comment: Credits shown in the About Hearsay window (en.lproj/Credits.rtf). Plain text; line breaks are kept. 'Settings > General > Acknowledgements' names the Settings tab, its General section, and the Acknowledgements section: use the translated names of those labels.
translation:
© 2026 Chihling Wang。MIT 授權。
包含開放原始碼軟體；請參閱「設定 > 一般 > 致謝」。
支持 Hearsay：Buy Me a Coffee

comment: Update progress. %@ is the new version.
Alert when Install and Relaunch is chosen while recording or transcribing
Update ready alert title and Settings line. %@ is the new version.

key: Hearsay cannot install the update here.
english: Hearsay cannot install the update here.
comment: Alert title: the running app cannot replace itself
translation: Hearsay 無法在此位置安裝更新。

key: Hearsay could not download the update.
english: Hearsay could not download the update.
comment: Alert title: the update download failed

key: Hearsay could not install the update.
english: Hearsay could not install the update.
comment: Alert title: staging or replacing the app bundle failed

key: Hearsay could not verify the downloaded update.
english: Hearsay could not verify the downloaded update.
comment: Alert title: checksum or code signature check of an update failed
translation: Hearsay 無法驗證下載的更新。

key: Hearsay will quit and open again as the new version.
english: Hearsay will quit and open again as the new version.
comment: Update ready alert
translation: Hearsay 會結束並以新版本重新開啟。

comment: Update available alert button: download and install the new version
Update ready alert button: replace the app and relaunch
Update progress. %@ is the new version.

key: Quit Hearsay and open it again.
english: Quit Hearsay and open it again.
comment: Alert when the automatic restart (language change or update) failed
translation: 請結束 Hearsay 後再次打開。

comment: Update progress window title

key: The checksum of %@ does not match the release's checksum list.
english: The checksum of %@ does not match the release's checksum list.
comment: Update verification error. %@ is a file name.
translation: %@ 的校驗和與此版本的校驗和清單不符。

key: The code signature of the new version is not valid: %@
english: The code signature of the new version is not valid: %@
comment: Update verification error. %@ is the Security framework's message.
translation: 新版本的程式碼簽署無效：%@

key: The disk image could not be opened: %@
english: The disk image could not be opened: %@
comment: Update verification error. %@ is the hdiutil error.

key: The disk image should contain one app but contains %lld.
english: The disk image should contain one app but contains %lld.
comment: Update verification error. %lld is a number of apps.
translation: 磁碟映像檔應只包含一個 App，但包含 %lld 個。

comment: Update download error. %@ is the underlying error.

key: The download page opens in your browser.
english: The download page opens in your browser.
comment: Update available alert, when the app cannot install the update itself
translation: 下載頁面會在瀏覽器中開啟。

key: The new app has the bundle identifier %@, not tw.og1o.hearsay.
english: The new app has the bundle identifier %@, not tw.og1o.hearsay.
comment: Update verification error. %@ is a bundle identifier.
translation: 新 App 的套件識別碼是 %@，而不是 tw.og1o.hearsay。

key: The new app is version %@, not %@.
english: The new app is version %1$@, not %2$@.
comment: Update verification error. %1$@ is the version found, %2$@ the release version.
translation: 新 App 的版本是 %1$@，而不是 %2$@。

key: The release has no disk image or checksum list.
english: The release has no disk image or checksum list.
comment: Update error
translation: 此版本沒有磁碟映像檔或校驗和清單。

key: The release's checksum list has no entry for %@.
english: The release's checksum list has no entry for %@.
comment: Update verification error. %@ is a file name.
translation: 此版本的校驗和清單中沒有 %@。

comment: Update progress. %@ is the new version.
Update alert button: open the release page in the browser
Update available alert. %@ is the installed version.

key: Hearsay cannot write to the folder %@. Move Hearsay to the Applications folder or another folder you can write to, open it from there, then check for updates again.
english: Hearsay cannot write to the folder %@. Move Hearsay to the Applications folder or another folder you can write to, open it from there, then check for updates again.
comment: Update install error. %@ is a folder path.
translation: Hearsay 無法寫入資料夾 %@。請將 Hearsay 移到「應用程式」資料夾或其他可寫入的資料夾，從那裡打開後再檢查更新。

key: Hearsay is running from the disk image. Drag Hearsay to the Applications folder, open it from there, then check for updates again.
english: Hearsay is running from the disk image. Drag Hearsay to the Applications folder, open it from there, then check for updates again.
comment: Update install error: the app runs from the mounted DMG
translation: Hearsay 正從磁碟映像檔執行。請將 Hearsay 拖到「應用程式」資料夾，從那裡打開後再檢查更新。

key: This copy of Hearsay is not an app bundle, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
english: This copy of Hearsay is not an app bundle, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
comment: Update install error
translation: 這份 Hearsay 不是 App 套件，無法自行更新。請從版本頁面下載新版本。

key: macOS is running Hearsay from a temporary location. Move Hearsay to the Applications folder, open it from there, then check for updates again.
english: macOS is running Hearsay from a temporary location. Move Hearsay to the Applications folder, open it from there, then check for updates again.
comment: Update install error: the app is translocated by Gatekeeper
translation: macOS 正從暫時位置執行 Hearsay。請將 Hearsay 移到「應用程式」資料夾，從那裡打開後再檢查更新。
